description: Sample of Polish street names for documentation and testing. Full street gazetteer (ULIC/TERYT) not yet bundled — streets are currently detected via pattern matching (ul./al./pl. prefix + name + building number) rather than gazetteer lookup. This sample is a placeholder for a future runtime gazetteer built with tools/build_pl_gazetteers.py --source teryt-ulic.
masking_rule: A street name alone must NOT be masked. Masking requires: street prefix (ul./al./pl./os.) + name + building number, optionally followed by postal code + city.
